        "label": "<LOC adaptive_dynamic_spawn_label> Dynamic Spawn Of Resources",
        "help": "<LOC adaptive_dynamic_spawn_help> Determine which mexes & hydros should be spawned.",
        "values": [

            "key": 1,
            "label": "<LOC adaptive_dynamic_spawn_key_1_label> mirror slots",
            "help": "<LOC adaptive_dynamic_spawn_key_1_help> Spawn resources for player & mirror slot (balanced resources)."

          {
            "key": 2,
            "label": "<LOC adaptive_dynamic_spawn_key_2_label> used slots",
            "help": "<LOC adaptive_dynamic_spawn_key_2_help> Only spawn resources for player on used slots (unbalanced resources)."

            "key": 3,
            "label": "<LOC adaptive_dynamic_spawn_key_3_label> no mirror = no resources",
